comment: Version-bearing external facts nextjs-ops states as current. Next.js caching and rendering semantics moved substantially at 15.0 (fetch uncached by default, async request APIs) and again at 16.0 (Cache Components / 'use cache', proxy.ts, Turbopack default), so a stale major here silently invalidates the highest-value section of the skill. check-nextjs-facts.py --offline asserts each prose_token is still named in the skill prose and that SKILL.md carries a dated currency note matching documented_major; --live asserts the npm package still resolves and its latest major still matches.
